Greene County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Simple Guide to Real Estate Auctions

Greene County, Virginia holds tax sales to collect unpaid property taxes. These public auctions offer buyers a chance to purchase real estate at lower prices while helping the county recover lost revenue. If you’re thinking about bidding, here’s everything you need to know.

How Tax Sales Work in Greene County

The county doesn’t hold tax sales on a fixed schedule. Instead, auctions happen when enough properties have overdue taxes.

  • Type of Sale: Public tax foreclosure auctions
  • Eligible Properties: Real estate with long-overdue tax balances
  • Where to Find Dates: Check the county’s website or auction platforms for upcoming sales

Tax Sale Details Explained

Knowing the process helps you avoid mistakes and bid with confidence. Here’s what you should expect:

  • Auction Location: Most sales happen in person at official Greene County locations. Some may also allow online bidding
  • Start Times: Times vary—each auction listing shows when it begins. All auctions follow Eastern Time
  • Registration Requirements:
    • You must register before the auction
    • Contact the treasurer’s office or auction company early to confirm deadlines
  • Redemption Rules:
    • Property owners can stop the sale by paying all back taxes, penalties, and fees before the auction
    • Once the auction ends, they can no longer redeem the property

Bidding and Payment Process

Winning the bid comes with a few important steps and payment rules.

  1. Highest Bidder Wins – The top bidder gets the property
  2. Deposit Requirement – The amount varies and is listed in the auction terms
  3. Accepted Payment Methods:
    • Certified funds
    • Cashier’s check
    • Money order
    • Wire transfer
    • No personal checks or cash accepted
  4. Final Balance: Must be paid by the deadline mentioned in the auction notice

Where to Get Auction Updates

Stay informed by checking these sources:

  • Greene County Treasurer’s Website – Greene County Real Estate Tax Sales
  • Auction Listings Platform – TACS Tax Sales provides real-time auction updates

Who to Contact for Tax Sale Info

If you have questions or need help with the process, reach out to:

  • Greene County Treasurer’s Office
  • Address: 40 Celt Road, Stanardsville, VA 22973
  • Phone: 434-985-5201
  • Email: treasurer@gcva.us

Pro Tips for Bidding at Greene County Tax Sales

To increase your chances of success, keep these tips in mind:

  • Smaller parcels near US-33 have potential but often come with slope challenges.
  • Budget for cleanup—many auction homes here have been vacant for a while.
  • Attend live auctions to catch any oral changes to terms on the spot.
